Game Overview

At its heart, Biozombie Outbreak is a shooter game about fend off relentless zombie waves in this intense third-person shooter. As a lone, skilled survivor, navigate an urban landscape, utilize firearms, and strategically eliminate your grotesque foes. Survive long enough to explore new zones, outsmart the hordes, and secure the city. Can you outlast the apocalypse?
